headline: CPU post-trained DSV4-Flash diverges from GPU reference on ~18% of next-tokens (teacher-forced, same prefix, same position, from token 1) -> REAL correctness bug, not bf16 noise. Localized to the CPU PREFILL ATTENTION-CORE path; MoE/C-kernels/rope/projections/softmax-scale EXONERATED by hard parity.
harness_validated: GPU + our harness on Flash-Base = 0.923 (1211/1311) vs published 0.908 -> harness is CORRECT; the low CPU number is not a harness artifact.

exonerated_with_evidence.C_kernels: CPU-eager-vs-GPU 0.822 == CPU-C-vs-GPU 0.818 -> bug is in the CPU COMMON path, not the wired C kernels. CPU-C vs CPU-eager per-layer = gradual accumulation (cos 0.9999->0.98), no cliff.
exonerated_with_evidence.MXFP4_MoE_kernel: in-situ kernel-vs-fp4-oracle cos=0.999997; e8m0 scale path correct; LUT/nibble match sglang authority
exonerated_with_evidence.MoE_overall: CPU FP4->bf16 MoE (independent of MXFP4 kernel) vs GPU = 0.821 == MXFP4 0.818 -> MoE fully exonerated
exonerated_with_evidence.rope_application: KROPE_SHADOW cos=1.000000 maxerr=0 (kernel rope == independent complex-multiply); YaRN freqs_cis computed by shared device-agnostic sglang precompute_freqs_cis
exonerated_with_evidence.fp8_projections: FP8_PARITY cos=1.000000 (q/k/kv/o proj fp8 W8A16 == torch block-dequant)
exonerated_with_evidence.softmax_scale: self.softmax_scale = head_dim**-0.5 in shared model code (deepseek_v4.py:665), no mscale on either side; flash_mla applies no internal mscale -> identical CPU/GPU

ruled_out_artifacts.position_offbyone: shift-0 agreement 0.822, all other shifts ~0.01 -> alignment correct
ruled_out_artifacts.greedy_amplification: teacher-forced removes it; divergence from position 1
ruled_out_artifacts.cross_build_per_layer_capture: INVALID tool: GPU-vs-CPU layer cosine ~0 + 50x-250x magnitude = different capture semantics across the two sglang builds (container vs venv), NOT a model signal

remaining_suspects: QK-norm RMS scope (nope-only vs full - flagged ambiguous in KROPE comment)

key_deductions.sparse_selection_is_noop_here: at ~1130-token ctx with index_topk=512 over ~9-280 compressed blocks, top-k selects ALL -> DSA sparse selection cannot be the bug at this context length; the divergence is in DENSE attention math
key_deductions.divergence_is_prefill: the teacher-forced capture is a single prefill forward; rope+proj (prefill-active) are clean -> the bug is in the prefill attention core, not decode-specific

next_decisive_test: ATTN_SHADOW with MAX_NEW>=2 (job 391271): batched MLA vs reference loop self-consistency; if it diverges, the attention-core impl is self-inconsistent. Then build an independent layer-0 attention reference to compare vs GPU.

TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.finding: The CPU-vs-GPU comparison was NEVER version-controlled. CPU plugin built on sglang 0.5.20.dev373; GPU reference runs container sglang 0.5.22.
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.nature: Only 7 dsv41 refs in 0.5.22 backend -> the ~2000-line growth is the V4 path ITSELF (new compress ratios 1/2, forward_low_ratio_sources, new flashmla scheduling), not V4.1 additions. DSV4 attention support was immature in 0.5.20 and substantially reworked by 0.5.22.
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.both_use_V4_path: checkpoint model_type=deepseek_v4 (not v41); container is_dsv41=False -> both run the V4 path, so V4.1 is NOT the issue; the V4 attention CODE differs by version
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.reframe: The 18% divergence localizes to the attention backend -- the exact subsystem that changed 2x between our 0.5.20 base and the 0.5.22 reference. So the divergence is heavily confounded by (and plausibly largely caused by) the version gap, NOT proven to be a CPU-plugin logic bug. Earlier 'CPU has a real bug' was OVER-ATTRIBUTED: never version-matched.
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.decisive_calibration: run upstream 0.5.22 natively on CPU (device=cpu, no plugin) if it works -> CPU-0.5.22 vs GPU-0.5.22 is version+code matched = pure hardware signal. If ~100%, divergence enters via plugin/0.5.20; if ~82%, inherent.
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.implication: The honest path may be to REBASE the CPU port onto sglang 0.5.22 (the matured DSV4 attention) rather than hunt a 'bug' in the 0.5.20-based port.

version_matched_proof.GPU-0.5.20_vs_GPU-0.5.22: 0.9775 (first_div ~64-80) -> sglang VERSION effect is only ~2%, benign/late; the 2577-line backend rewrite barely changes V4-path outputs
version_matched_proof.CPU-0.5.20_vs_GPU-0.5.22: 0.818 (first_div pos 1) -- same as matched -> version NOT the cause

corrected_conclusions: RETRACTED: the 'version-confound' triage. Two GPU versions agree 97.8%; version explains only ~2% of the divergence, not the 18%.
CONFIRMED + version-controlled: a REAL ~16% CPU-plugin divergence from GPU (82% vs the 97.8% GPU-vs-GPU floor), from POSITION 1, in the CPU MLA attention core.

It is a shared-blindspot defect: every CPU-internal parity probe passes (rope cos=1, proj cos=1, MoE 0.999997) yet CPU differs from GPU -> CPU matches its OWN oracle but not the authoritative computation.
DEFINITIVE_CALIBRATION.next: Build an INDEPENDENT (non-CPU-oracle) attention reference from the authoritative model math to break the shared blindspot and localize the attention-core defect (batched MLA algorithm / QK-norm scope / fp8-KV precision).

what_is_proven: Real bug: CPU vs GPU teacher-forced top-1 = 0.82, version-controlled (GPU-0.5.20 vs GPU-0.5.22 floor = 0.978), from position 1.
Real-world impact: gsm8k CPU ~0.58-0.77 vs GPU ~0.92 on the SAME post-trained checkpoint.
Character: CPU attention is ~2x flatter/more-diffuse (top1-top2 gap 2.875 vs 5.875); 85% of errors are near-misses (right candidate set, wrong rank).
Exonerated by hard parity: MoE (0.999997), C-kernels (eager==C vs GPU), rope (cos 1.0), projections (cos 1.0), softmax_scale (identical), sglang version (~2% only).
SESSION_CONSOLIDATION.GPU_reference_precision: FlashMLA computes QK^T + softmax in FP32 (softmax_lse is fp32), bf16/fp8 operands. Our eager _batched_mla_attend (line 1709) truncates QK to bf16 (torch.matmul(bf16,bf16)->bf16 then .float() too late). The C sparse_attend_masked computes QK in fp32.
SESSION_CONSOLIDATION.KEY_UNRESOLVED: The teacher-forced capture is PREFILL; provenance shows _batched_mla_attend (decode attention) did NOT mark sparse_attend during it -> the PREFILL attention path that produced the 0.82 divergence is NOT yet identified. _torch_flash_mla_with_kvcache is installed for all flash_mla calls (line 2486) but either returns early in prefill or prefill uses a different compute. MUST identify the exact prefill attention op before fixing.
SESSION_CONSOLIDATION.next_concrete_step: Instrument the ACTUAL prefill attention op with per-op I/O capture (q,k,v,sink,out) at layer 0; write an INDEPENDENT fp32 MLA reference from the authoritative formula; feed it the captured GPU inputs (validate reference == GPU out) then CPU inputs (localize: if CPU-out != reference(CPU-in) the compute is wrong; if equal but CPU-in != GPU-in the bug is upstream).
SESSION_CONSOLIDATION.recommendation: This needs careful instrumented debugging (not quick toggles); each real-weight run is ~15min load. Either (a) invest in the per-op I/O reference harness, or (b) given GPU proves the model+harness are correct and CPU runs coherently at ~0.6-0.77, decide whether to pursue the fix now vs document the known-gap and proceed.

ATTENTION_SUBOP_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT.goal: oracle-anchored per-op localization: compare attn_in/q_final/q_lora/attn_out at layer 0, GPU-0.5.20 vs CPU-0.5.20, same frozen seq
ATTENTION_SUBOP_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT.result: CAPTURE NOT CROSS-COMPARABLE. Output logits agree 0.813 on the SAME 1166-token seq (coherent, token-aligned) -> runs are correct. But per-op tensors show token-0 cos ~0.1-0.3 on DETERMINISTIC quantities (q_lora token0 must be identical) -> the capture grabs non-comparable tensors across configs.
confounds_identified: TP MISMATCH: GPU runs tp=4 (149GB model needs 4x H200=376GB; won't fit 1x 94GB), so q_final is head-sharded (16=64/4 heads, rank-0 only) vs CPU tp=1 (64 heads). Need to GATHER all 4 ranks' shards to reconstruct comparable q_final.
CHUNKED PREFILL: GPU captured 256 tokens (first chunk) vs CPU 1167 (full). Comparable only on overlap, but even token 0 diverges -> not just this.

ARG/SEMANTIC heuristic: 'first 2D float tensor' + rank-0 capture resolve to DIFFERENT semantic tensors on native-GPU MQALayer vs plugin-CPU MQALayer (MHC-deferred residual, rope phase, arg order). attn_in is full-width (4096, NOT sharded) yet token0 cos=0.07 -> wrong tensor grabbed, not TP.
ATTENTION_SUBOP_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT.clean_signal_we_DO_have: OUTPUT LOGITS (teacher-forced, token-aligned, config-robust): CPU 0.81 vs the GPU-vs-GPU 0.98 floor -> REAL attention-path bug from token 1, confirmed not MoE/kernels/rope-app/version.
ATTENTION_SUBOP_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT.to_actually_pinpoint: Need a SEMANTICALLY-EXACT per-op capture: (1) gather ALL tp ranks' head shards to rebuild full q_final/attn core; (2) capture by EXACT kwarg name per MQALayer.forward signature (not heuristic); (3) run GPU at the SAME effective config (tp accounted for, chunked-prefill off or first-chunk aligned). This is a focused instrumentation build, ~1-2 more iterations.
ATTENTION_SUBOP_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT.honest_status: Bug is REAL, version-controlled, localized to the attention path, from token 1; ~16 points below the correctness floor. NOT yet pinpointed to a line. Every cheap cross-config per-op capture so far is confounded by TP/chunking/arg-semantics.

STEP2_fp32_precision_RULED_OUT.result: CPU-fp32fix vs GPU = 0.8185 == baseline 0.8214 (no change). Provenance: sparse_attend C-kernel ran (c_kernel=86, eager=0) -> the attention core was ALREADY fp32 (C sparse_attend_masked does q.to(fp32)).
STEP2_fp32_precision_RULED_OUT.conclusion: QK/softmax PRECISION is NOT the bug. The fp32 attention core still diverges 82%. The attention is fed DIFFERENT INPUTS (upstream) or the KV content differs -> look UPSTREAM of the attention core: MHC-pre (hc_pre runs on layers 0-2), input_layernorm, or the compressed-KV path.
STEP2_fp32_precision_RULED_OUT.sharpened_hypothesis: attn_in (self_attn input, post-norm+MHC-pre) showed token-0 divergence with matching norm. Since token 0 is deterministic, either (a) MHC-pre/norm genuinely differs CPU-vs-GPU (REAL bug upstream of attention), or (b) capture artifact. Disambiguate by capturing the DETERMINISTIC embedding (DecoderLayer layer-0 input hidden_states, must match) vs attn_in.

STEP1_exact_capture_BLOCKED.attempt: exact-arg-index capture of layer_in (embedding anchor) + attn_in on GPU-native vs CPU-plugin, version-matched 0.5.20, same frozen tokens
STEP1_exact_capture_BLOCKED.blocker: DSV4 maintains the hidden stream as hc_mult=4 PARALLEL MHC CLUSTERS [N,4,hidden] (num_tokens,hc_mult,hidden_size=x.shape). The layer-0 'embedding anchor' came out orthogonal (cos 0.073) with different norms (CPU cluster 6.26 vs GPU 10.937) even though token-0 is deterministic. All 4 clusters identical within each leg (embedding replicated) but CPU-vs-GPU orthogonal + 1.75x norm ratio -> NOT cluster permutation (tested: best-perm cos still 0.073).
STEP1_exact_capture_BLOCKED.root_difficulty: Per-op tensor capture across the GPU-NATIVE sglang path and our CPU-PLUGIN path does not yield comparable quantities: the positional-arg a[1] resolves to DIFFERENT tensors on the two code paths (different wrapping/signature), compounded by the MHC 4-cluster hidden representation, TP sharding (GPU tp=4 vs CPU tp=1), and chunked prefill. Every 'deterministic anchor' comes out orthogonal -> the anchor is mis-captured, not the model differing. Repeated across many capture iterations.
STEP1_exact_capture_BLOCKED.clean_signal_remains: OUTPUT logits (teacher-forced, token-aligned): CPU 0.81 vs GPU-vs-GPU 0.98 floor = real bug, from token1. Precision RULED OUT (step 2). Everything else exonerated.
STEP1_exact_capture_BLOCKED.honest_conclusion: The bug is REAL, version-controlled, localized to the attention/MHC/upstream path, NOT precision/MoE/kernels/rope/version. Line-level pinpoint is BLOCKED by the difficulty of capturing provably-comparable intermediates across two very different implementations of a complex MHC-cluster-architecture model. This needs either (a) the model authors' reference inference code as the oracle (not sglang-GPU, whose code path differs from our plugin), or (b) a deep, careful instrumentation that identifies a provably-identical semantic boundary in BOTH paths -- substantial focused work, not rapid toggles.
STEP1_exact_capture_BLOCKED.compute_spent: many ~15-min real-weight capture runs; diminishing returns on per-op capture.
